question: Which river has its source in the Western Ghats range of Karnataka state?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Kaveri**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Kaveri River** originates from the **Western Ghats** range in the **Karnataka state**.
 
• The source of the Kaveri is at **Tala Kaveri** in the **Brahmagiri hills** of the **Coorg (Kodagu) district** in Karnataka.
 
• It flows through the states of **Karnataka** and **Tamil Nadu** before emptying into the **Bay of Bengal**.
 
• The river is considered sacred in Hinduism and is often referred to as the **Ganges of the South**.
 
• Important tributaries of the Kaveri include the **Hemavati, Shimsha, Arkavathy, Bhavani, Noyyal**, and **Amaravati** rivers.
 
• The river supports several important reservoirs and dams like the **Krishna Raja Sagara (KRS) Dam** in Karnataka and the **Mettur Dam** in Tamil Nadu.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Sarayu**__

 __
 
• The **Sarayu River** is a major river in the Indian state of **Uttar Pradesh**.
 
• It is considered sacred in Hinduism and is associated with the city of **Ayodhya**, the birthplace of Lord Rama.
 
• The river eventually merges with the **Ganges River**.
 
 
 
• **Banas**__
 __
 
• The **Banas River** is a river in **Rajasthan**, India.
 
• It originates in the **Aravalli Range** and flows through Rajasthan before joining the **Chambal River**.
 
 
 
• **Kosi**__
 
 
• The **Kosi River** is also known as the **"Sorrow of Bihar"** due to its frequent flooding.
 
• The river originates in **Tibet** and flows through **Nepal** and **India**.
 
• It forms a left-bank tributary of the **Ganges River**.
